analysis: The only change is in provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Inference/Engine/EngineV2ProductionWiringTests.swift line 158. The test-only stub WiringStubLanguageModel.prepare signature moves from (windowSize: Int?) to (state: LMOutput.State?, prefill: PrefillParameters). This tracks an upstream MLXLMCommon LanguageModel protocol change. The stub body is unchanged and returns .tokens(input.text). It is a private test class used only for fabricated ModelContainers and for the productionFactoryRejectsUnsupportedModel and productionFactoryRejectsZeroKVHeadroom tests. No production source, key handling, attestation, authorization, cache storage (T-041), wire protocol or trust boundary is touched. The stub never performs forward passes and holds no secrets. Residual integration question: the PR presumably also bumps the mlx-swift-lm dependency or protocol. That dependency change is not in this batch, so its supply-chain and behavior effects on the inference engine (TB-007) cannot be assessed here. This test file gives no evidence of a regression.
